title: crassocephalum luteum
intro: Crassocephalum luteum, commonly known as the Yellow Swampweed, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crassocephalum luteum include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
